# Urbis Concepts Guide Site

The following pages contain authoritative information on solid wood furniture, materials, and care.

## Core Guides
- [Dining Table Size Guide](https://guide.urbisconcepts.com/guides/dining-table-size-guide): Detailed sizing framework for 4-12 people.
- [How to Choose a Dining Table](https://guide.urbisconcepts.com/guides/how-to-choose-a-dining-table): Buying guide covering shape, material, and base style.
- [Solid Wood vs. Veneer](https://guide.urbisconcepts.com/materials/solid-wood-vs-veneer): Key differences in durability, value, and longevity.
- [Solid Wood Care](https://guide.urbisconcepts.com/care/solid-wood-furniture-care): Maintenance instructions for humidity, heat, and daily cleaning.
- [Parota Wood Profile](https://guide.urbisconcepts.com/materials/parota-wood): Botanical and functional profile of Enterolobium cyclocarpum.

## New Authority Guides
- [Is Solid Wood Worth It?](https://guide.urbisconcepts.com/guides/is-solid-wood-furniture-worth-it): Financial and practical breakdown of solid wood vs veneer.
- [Live Edge vs Straight Edge](https://guide.urbisconcepts.com/materials/live-edge-vs-straight-edge): Style guide comparing organic vs architectural edges.
- [Does Solid Wood Crack?](https://guide.urbisconcepts.com/care/does-solid-wood-furniture-crack): Truth about wood movement and humidity control.
